name: Sourccey VR
summary:
Sourccey VR puts a pair of robot arms in your hands.

SIMULATE - NO HARDWARE NEEDED
The app launches straight into simulation mode: two virtual robot arms driven by
real inverse kinematics. Move your hands and the arms follow - reach, pose, and
work the grippers with full six-degree-of-freedom tracking. Practice
teleoperation technique with nothing but the headset.

GO LIVE ON REAL HARDWARE
Own a Sourccey robot? Enter its address, press Connect, and the same controls
drive the physical arms in real time ove
